column1: # The arm64 object check's files still judged against llvm-mc 23.1.5's recorded objects (test/asm/records/obj-*-llvm-mc-23.1.5.edn),
# each with the reason it has no words of its own that the object verdict judges whole: CORPUS/NAME<TAB>REASON (judge-rest, the
# user's goal of 2026-11-20: the object check judged by the test's own words wherever it states them). Every other file of the
# object check's corpora (bin/repr-asm --arch arm64 object-check: a64-musl, a64-synthetic, mc-aarch64-obj) is judged by its own
# words, arbace.asm.arm64.objcheck's own-rows: its object runs' CHECK lines (piped, or since judge-rest written to %t on one RUN
# line and read by a viewer on a later one) and its -show-encoding runs' stated encodings held to the words of Arbace's object,
# every one met; their byte-for-byte comparison with the record is the oracle tier's (object-check --oracle, asm-arm64-object-oracle).
# A file listed here that its own words judge whole is stale, one not listed whose words are not judged whole is refused
# (:not-own): bin/repr-asm --arch arm64 object-check fails on either. Read by bin/repr-asm (awk), `#` lines comments.
